ValidationRule.description: Once a trip is approved, its approved details cannot change. Replaces the approval-process record lock, which also blocked booking references, expenses and claim submission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed") ), OR( ISCHANGED(Purpose__c), ISCHANGED(Trip_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Destination_City__c), ISCHANGED(Start_Date__c), ISCHANGED(End_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Estimated_Cost__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This trip is already approved. Its purpose, destination, dates and estimated cost can no longer be changed.
